brand.name: VITALNEX
brand.disclaimer: VITALNEX is a research and decision-support prototype. It does not diagnose disease, prescribe treatment, or replace a qualified healthcare professional.

hero.title: Your health. Your intelligence. Your care — connected.
hero.subtitle: A human-centered clinical AI ecosystem combining transparent risk assessment, verifiable AI Trust Passports, and connected regional care.

assess.prefilledNotice: Some answers were filled in from your saved health profile and are marked "From your profile". Please check each one before you continue.
assess.bmiRangeError: This height and weight give a BMI of {bmi}, which is outside 12–70. Please check them.

q.ageHelp: You must be 18 or older to use the screening.
q.sexHelp: Used only for the risk calculation.
q.highBp: Has a doctor or nurse ever told you that you have high blood pressure?
q.highChol: Has a doctor or nurse ever told you that your cholesterol is high?
q.smoker: Have you smoked at least 100 cigarettes (5 packs) in your life?
q.smokerHelp: Answer yes even if you have stopped smoking.
q.physActivity: In the past 30 days, did you do any physical activity or exercise other than your regular job?
q.fruits: Do you eat fruit at least once a day?
q.veggies: Do you eat vegetables at least once a day?
q.heavyAlcohol: Do you drink more than 14 drinks a week (men) / 7 a week (women)?
q.genHealth: In general, how is your health?
q.mentHealth: In the past 30 days, how many days was your mental health not good?
q.physHealth: In the past 30 days, how many days was your physical health not good?
q.diffWalk: Do you have serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs?

bmi.label: Your BMI
bmi.normal: in the healthy range for South Asian adults
bmi.overweight: overweight for South Asian adults (23 or more)
bmi.obese: obese range for South Asian adults (27.5 or more)
bmi.note: BMI guidance uses Asian-Indian cut-offs: overweight from 23, obese from 27.5. BMI does not show everything about your health.

under18.title: The screening is only for adults (18 or older)
under18.body: VITALNEX was built from data about adults, so it cannot give a result for people under 18. If you are worried about your health, please talk to a doctor or a trusted adult. In an emergency, call 108 / 112.

symptoms.intro: Do you have any of these right now? Tick all that apply.
symptoms.stroke_signs: Sudden face drooping, arm weakness or difficulty speaking
symptoms.tickedWarning: These can be signs of an emergency. Call 108 / 112 now. Do not wait for a screening result.
symptoms.freeText: Anything else you want to tell us?
symptoms.freeTextHelp: Only checked for emergency warning signs. It is not saved.

review.intro: Please check your answers. You can go back and change any of them.
review.consentNote: Your answers are processed only if you allowed it in My data → Consent. They are saved to your history only if you turned on saving.

errors.signin: Please sign in again to use the screening.
errors.consent: To run a screening, please turn on "Process my answers to give me a screening result" in your consent settings.
errors.validation: Some answers were not accepted. Please check them and try again.
errors.notFound: This result could not be found.
errors.unavailable: The screening service is not available right now. Nothing was saved and no result was made. If you have symptoms such as chest pain, call 108 / 112.

results.title: Your screening results
results.disclaimer: VITALNEX is a screening and care-navigation prototype. It does not diagnose disease, does not recommend medicines, and does not replace a qualified healthcare professional. If you have chest pain, signs of stroke or severe breathlessness, call 108 / 112 now.

conditionShort.heart: heart disease or a heart attack

similar.low: Your answers are less similar to people who have been told they have {condition}.
similar.moderate: Your answers are somewhat similar to people who have been told they have {condition}.
similar.high: Your answers are similar to people who have been told they have {condition}.

results.notConfidentBody: VITALNEX is not confident about your answers for this condition, so no level is shown. Please see a doctor.

abstainReason.conformal_uncertain: Your answers fall where the model could go either way.
abstainReason.out_of_distribution: Your answers are unlike most of the people the model learned from.

correct_inputs.title: Please correct your answers
correct_inputs.body: Some answers do not look possible.

not_confident.title: VITALNEX is not confident for you. Please see a doctor.
not_confident.body: For at least one condition the screening could not give a confident level.

see_doctor_soon.title: See a doctor soon (within 2 weeks)
see_doctor_soon.body: At least one condition is at the High level. A doctor can check this properly.

discuss_next_checkup.title: Discuss this at your next check-up
discuss_next_checkup.body: At least one condition is at the Moderate level.

routine_checkup.title: Keep up regular check-ups
routine_checkup.body: All three conditions are at the Low level. Low does not mean no risk.

results.queued: A clinician will review this result.
results.notStored: This result was not saved to your history, because saving is turned off in your consent settings.

notes.age_under_40_less_reliable: Results are less reliable for people under 40. In testing, VITALNEX missed more cases in younger people than in older people.
notes.sex_not_stated_higher_band_used: You chose not to say your sex, so VITALNEX checked both and shows the higher level for each condition.
notes.no_clinician_review_without_consent: This result would normally be sent for clinician review, but sharing with clinicians is turned off in your consent settings.

warnings.excellent_health_but_many_unwell_days: You rated your health as excellent but reported many days of not feeling well. Please check these answers.
warnings.excellent_health_but_difficulty_walking: You rated your health as excellent but reported serious difficulty walking. Please check these answers.

why.title: Why this result?
why.intro: The answers that mattered most for each condition.
why.none: No factors are shown when VITALNEX is not confident.

change.title: What you can change
change.intro: The smallest realistic change in your answers that would lower a level.
change.unavailable: Suggestions are not available right now.
change.suggestion: If {changes}, the level for {condition} could move from {from} to {to}.
change.already_low: Already at the Low level. Keep up healthy habits and regular check-ups.
change.abstained: No suggestion, because VITALNEX is not confident for this condition. Please see a doctor.
change.no_small_change_found: No small change in the answers you can change lowered this level. A doctor can help you plan next steps.
change.controlNote: Blood pressure and cholesterol are not changed here. If you have been told you have them, keep them under control with your doctor.

changeText.ment_health_days: your mental health was not good on {v} days a month
changeText.phys_health_days: your physical health was not good on {v} days a month

sure.title: How sure is VITALNEX?
sure.intro: When VITALNEX is not confident, it shows no level and asks you to see a doctor.
sure.missRate: In testing, for every 100 people who had been told they have {condition}, about {n} were shown as Low.

shared.title: Shared factors
shared.intro: Answers that mattered for more than one condition.
shared.none: No answer mattered for more than one condition in this result.

features.HighBP: Told you have high blood pressure

guidance.title: General guidance
guidance.intro: From public WHO and ICMR material. Not personal medical advice.

correct.title: Please check your answers
correct.body: Some answers do not look possible, so no result was made.
correct.bmi: Your height and weight give a BMI outside 12–70.

whatIf.title: What if…?
whatIf.intro: Change the answers you can change and see how the levels would move. Nothing is saved.
whatIf.noChanges: Change at least one answer first.
whatIf.fixedNote: Age, sex, blood pressure, cholesterol and difficulty walking are not changed here.
whatIf.smokerNote: The question asks whether you have ever smoked 100 cigarettes, so the answer cannot change back. Quitting still lowers your real-world risk of heart disease and stroke.
whatIf.estimateNote: These are estimates from the model, not a promise. This is not a diagnosis.

emergency.title: Call for emergency help now
emergency.body: The symptoms you reported can be signs of a heart attack or stroke. Call an ambulance now. Do not drive yourself.
emergency.noScores: No screening levels are shown, because these symptoms need urgent care.

historyPage.subtitle: Your saved screenings. Levels only — this is not a diagnosis.
historyPage.trendIntro: Each line is one condition. A gap means VITALNEX was not confident that time.
historyPage.trendAria: Chart of screening levels over time for diabetes, heart disease and stroke
historyPage.trendEmpty: No levels to show over time yet.
historyPage.emptyBody: Your screening results will appear here after you complete a screening with saving turned on.
historyPage.emergencyRow: Emergency symptoms reported — no levels shown
historyPage.hiddenBody: You withdrew consent to keep your screening history, so it is not shown. You can turn it on again in My data → Consent.

healthProfilePage.subtitle: The same questions as the screening. Every answer is optional here.

healthProfilePage.languageHelp: The language for VITALNEX and your results.
healthProfilePage.languageFailed: The language was changed on this device but could not be saved to your account.

case.title: Case review
case.notFound: This case is not available. The patient may have withdrawn clinician sharing.
case.orderNote: For each condition, the main factors and the model's uncertainty are shown first and the model's level last, so the level does not anchor your judgement.
case.noFactors: No factors stored for this condition.

abstainReason.out_of_distribution: Answers are outside the training data (out of distribution).

case.thresholdsUnknown: Thresholds not available: this result came from a model version that is not loaded now.
case.noResults: No model ran for this screening (for example, emergency symptoms were reported).
case.emergency: Emergency symptoms were reported in this screening.
case.nextStep: Next step shown to the patient
case.dqUnavailable: Data-quality notes are not available for these answers.
case.historyIntro: Calibrated probability per screening. A gap means the model abstained or did not run.
case.notQueued: This screening is not in the review queue.
case.noteHelp: The patient sees this note with their result. Do not name or dose medicines.
case.errChooseOne: Choose at least one condition to override, or choose Agree.
case.errBand: Choose a new level that differs from the model's level.
case.errReason: A reason is required for every override.
case.errOtherNote: Add a note when the reason is "Other".
case.saved: Review saved. The patient will see that a clinician reviewed this result.
case.notTraining: Overrides are logged for accountability. They are never used to retrain the models.

what.title: What VITALNEX is, and is not

items.screening: A screening tool: it estimates how similar your answers are to people who have been told they have diabetes or prediabetes, heart disease or stroke.
items.care_navigation: Care navigation: it tells you what kind of care to seek and how soon.
items.validated_on_indian_patients: Validated on Indian patients (it was trained on US survey data)

data.title: Data
data.name: Dataset
data.prevalence: Share of people with each condition

models.title: Models, per condition
models.aurocHelp: How well the model ranks people with the condition above people without it (0.5 = chance, 1 = perfect).
models.brierHelp: Average error of the probabilities (lower is better).
models.recall: Recall at the Moderate threshold (95% CI)
models.recallHelp: Of people with the condition, the share placed in Moderate or High.
models.miss: Miss rate in the Low band
models.missHelp: Of people in the test set who had the condition, this share were placed in Low. Low does not mean no risk.
models.reliabilityAlt: Reliability plot for {condition}: predicted probability against observed rate on the test set.
models.shapAlt: Global SHAP plot for {condition}: average effect of each answer on the model.

fairness.title: Fairness
fairness.intro: Recall and false-positive rate per group on the test set. Income, education and healthcare access are used only for this audit and are never asked in the app.
fairness.ageGap: Age gap ({condition}): recall is {yr} for ages {young} and {or} for ages {old}. People under {age} see a note that results are less reliable for them.

abst.title: Abstention and coverage
abst.intro: When the model is not confident, VITALNEX shows no level and asks the person to see a doctor.
abst.liveNote: Counts only include people who agreed to anonymous safety statistics.
abst.liveAbstained: Not confident for at least one condition

principles.title: NITI Aayog principle map
principles.intro: Each Responsible AI principle, the features that implement it, and live evidence. Missing evidence is shown as "not available".
principles.loadFailed: The principle map could not be loaded.

myData.title: My data
myData.subtitle: Your consents, a copy of your data, and deletion. Changes apply immediately.
myData.loadFailed: Your consents could not be loaded.
myData.changeFailed: The change was not saved. Your consent is unchanged.

assessment_processing.title: Process my answers to give me a screening result
assessment_processing.notice: VITALNEX uses the answers you type in the screening form to estimate how similar your answers are to people who have been told they have diabetes or prediabetes, heart disease or stroke. The calculation runs on the VITALNEX server; your answers are not sent to any other company.

store_history.title: Save my results so I can see my history
store_history.notice: Your answers and results are saved so you can see your history and trend, download a report and create a share link.
store_history.effect: Each result is shown once and not saved. Your saved history is hidden while this is off.

share_with_clinician.title: Let VITALNEX clinicians review my results
share_with_clinician.notice: Results that are high, uncertain or flagged as an emergency are put in a review list for VITALNEX clinicians. A clinician can see your answers, results and history while this is on.
share_with_clinician.effect: No clinician review. If a result is high or uncertain, you are told to see a doctor directly. Clinicians lose access immediately.

aggregate_audit.title: Count my results in anonymous safety statistics
aggregate_audit.notice: Your results are counted, without your name, in totals that VITALNEX administrators use to check how the system behaves (for example how often it is not confident).
aggregate_audit.effect: Your results are left out of governance statistics.

export.title: Download a copy of my data
export.body: A JSON file with everything VITALNEX holds about you: profile, consents, saved answers, screenings, reviews, shares and appointments.
export.failed: The export could not be created. Please try again later.

delete.title: Delete my data
delete.body: Removes your screenings, saved answers, shares, consents, profile and account. Only a minimal record that a deletion happened is kept. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogBody: Type DELETE to confirm. You will be signed out and your account will no longer exist.
delete.failed: Deletion failed. Nothing was deleted, or only part of it; please try again or contact the team.

myData.shareLink: Share my record with a QR code
myData.staffNote: Consent settings and data rights apply to patient accounts. Your role does not hold patient-style personal data here.

settingsPage.subtitle: Language and, for patients, your data and consents.
settingsPage.languageHelp: Applies to the whole app on this device.

share.title: Share my record (QR)
share.intro: Create a read-only link and QR code to show a doctor. You choose what is included and how long it works. You can revoke it at any time.
share.createFailed: The link could not be created.
share.createdNote: This link is shown only once. Copy it or show the QR code now. Only a scrambled (hashed) version is stored.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
share.qrAlt: QR code for your share link
share.listEmpty: You have not created any share links.
share.listFailed: Your share links could not be loaded.
share.revokeFailed: The link could not be revoked.
share.historyOff: Your history consent is off, so a share shows no results until you turn it back on.

public.title: Shared screening summary
public.sharedBy: Shared by the patient. Expires at {date}.
public.readOnly: Read-only. Nothing on this page can be changed.
public.notice: This is a screening summary, not a diagnosis. Levels show how similar the patient's answers are to people who have been told they have each condition. In an emergency call 108 / 112.
public.expiredBody: Ask the patient to create a new share link.
public.revokedBody: The patient has stopped sharing this record.
public.invalidBody: Check that the whole link was copied.
public.historyHidden: The patient's saved history is hidden because they turned off saving their history.

reportsPage.subtitle: Share your record with a doctor, and see your saved screenings.
